docs: Visual inspiration only, with no code copied, from a public promo clip (https://x.com/malikyoloo/status/2115675118357909597) and the charts page it points at (https://www.mebius.design/freebies/charts). The original kit is proprietary and forbids reuse inside a library or design system. This item is an original implementation. Series use the host tokens --chart-1 through --chart-5. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme. Numbers follow the locale (es maps to es-MX, en to en-US). Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
